from pathlib import Path
import json

home=Path.home()
data=home/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
states=home/".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks"
source="DEV-PRED-CONT-CANARY2-A-20261003-E022"
cid="CONT-e91d594cb6c782b9e7b2668d"

def load(p):
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None

s=load(states/f"{source}.json")
cp=data/"continuations"/f"{cid}.json"
c=load(cp)
loc=[]
event_id=None
if isinstance(c,dict):
    event_id=c.get("last_event_id")
    if event_id:
        for n in ("outbox","inflight","sent"):
            if (data/n/f"{event_id}.json").is_file():
                loc.append(n)

assert isinstance(s,dict), "A_STATE_MISSING"
assert s.get("status")=="DISPATCHED", "A_NOT_DISPATCHED"
assert s.get("auto_continue") is True, "A_AUTO_FALSE"
assert cp.is_file(), "A_CONTINUATION_RECORD_MISSING"
assert isinstance(c,dict), "A_CONTINUATION_INVALID"
assert c.get("continuation_id")==cid, "A_CONTINUATION_ID_WRONG"
assert c.get("source_task_id")==source, "A_CONTINUATION_SOURCE_WRONG"
assert c.get("state") in {"CONTINUE_REQUESTED","CONTINUE_QUEUED","CONTINUE_SENT","NEXT_TASK_CREATED","NEXT_TASK_ACCEPTED"}, "A_CONTINUATION_BAD_STATE"
assert event_id, "A_CONTINUATION_NO_EVENT"
assert loc, "A_CONTINUATION_EVENT_NOT_FOUND"
print("CANARY2_A_CONTINUATION_EXISTS=PASS")
